summary.text: Jeff Myers is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 42, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Myers is a former Missouri State Highway Patrol trooper and a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Myers was born in Missouri and lives in Warrenton, and graduated from Warren County R-III High School in 1987.
He earned a bachelor's degree in physical education from Central Methodist College in 1993.
His career experience includes working as a trooper with the Missouri State Highway Patrol and as a business owner.
In the Missouri House, Myers was assigned to the House General Laws Committee and the Joint Committee on the Justice System for 2025-2026.
His 2023-2024 assignments were the Public Safety, House General Laws and Transportation committees.
